Branch: the root no longer works on the platform-assigned claude/<name> branch; it creates conventionally named branches. claude.ai: interactive cloud sessions have no documented setting for branch pushes; pushes were historically limited to claude/* branches (claude-code#24535) and later reports show the selected branch being pushable (#91018); routines have 'Allow unrestricted branch pushes' per repository (claude.ai/code/routines, edit routine, Permissions). Window: keep 450000 and add a short 'Why 450000' with the cost model (each call re-reads the context at the cache-read price, $0.20/MTok for Opus 5.5; no long-context price tier; compaction costs a summary call and a cold cache rewrite), the optimum formula W* = B + sqrt(2g((r+w)B + oS)/r), a compact table (scenarios B/g with optimum and 450k overhead: 30k/2k: 114k, +42%; 50k/5k: 202k, +16%; 50k/10k: 265k, +7%; 80k/15k: 384k, +1%; Claude Code's ~967K default costs 20-120% more than the optimum), and why 450000 stays: the model leaves out re-orientation after each compaction and quality loss from more frequent lossy compaction (Anthropic context-engineering post), and the root's measured growth (docs/decisions.md) sits in the high-g scenarios where 450k is near flat; 300k is the cost-only minimax and a reasonable choice for light sessions. Codex: compaction at 90% of the window; the Sol window figure conflicts between sources (500k vs 272k), so say that rather than asserting 450k. Settings: modelSettings, /autocompact, CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW.
